baseline.reason: The intro commit (f8d429e0c569) rewrote the showcqt filter, changing the `fps` option from a bounded integer [10–100] to AV_OPT_TYPE_VIDEO_RATE with no enforced bounds. This allows fps=1, which produces step = sample_rate / (fps * count) = 44100 / (1*1) = 44100, far exceeding fft_len = 8192. After the first CQT plot, remaining_fill is set to step (44100). On the next filter_frame call, j = fft_len - remaining_fill = 8192 - 44100 = -35908, and the loop writes to fft_data[j+m] — a massive OOB heap
